text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'arcadia-prod' GPU utilization 99%. Queue depth spiking for tenant 'arcadia-health'. Triggering paging policies. PD: SRE-Oncall.
Maya Chen: paging SRE-Oncall now — PD fired. looks like single tenant causing the spike.
Devon Patel (oncall): on it. seeing long queues and token latency > 10s for arcadia-health. confirming dedicated pool arcadia-prod is at 100% GPU util.
Alex Rivera: quick check — is autoscale enabled for arcadia-prod? metrics show no recent scale events. could be stuck at max_nodes.
Irene Koh: arcadia-prod is dedicated reserved with burst option off by default. we can enable burst override to use shared burst capacity, expensive but immediate.
Tony Zhang: @Priya Singh FYI — Arcadia Health, enterprise contract. If we enable burst we'll hit billing thresholds. Are they on a commit that covers this?
Priya Singh: oncall account lead here. they have an allocated commit but no burst in their contract. we need sign-off to use emergency burst; please patch them ASAP.
Devon Patel: my proposal — manual scale: add 2 gpus to the pool (hot-path) and enable burst for 30m as fallback. that should clear queue.
Alex Rivera: can run this now: 
```
rictl pool scale --pool arcadia-prod --add-gpus 2 --reason "incident: temporary emergency scale for arcadia-health"
rictl pool set-burst --pool arcadia-prod --enable --ttl 1800
```
Devon Patel: running the scale command now. tailing scheduler logs.
Incident Bot: ACTION: Scale job started by devon. job_id=scale-1748004321-01. ETA ~3m.
Support Bot: Noted — opening a customer incident page and email template prepped.
Alex Rivera: pool health checks showing new GPUs registering. KV cache warm-up in progress — connections rebalanced.
Irene Koh: enabling burst TTL 30m as agreed. enabling now.
Incident Bot: ACTION: Burst enabled for arcadia-prod, TTL 1800s.
Devon Patel: queue depth dropping. latency falling back to normal ~200-500ms. letting traffic drain on new capacity.
Priya Singh: called Arcadia Health primary contact — told them we're doing emergency scale and may invoice per emergency burst policy. they acknowledged; asked for post-incident summary.
Tony Zhang: good. please capture exact cost delta and timeframe. we'll need legal approval if > $Xk.
Irene Koh: creating follow-up tasks: 1) investigate why autoscale didn't trigger (metrics, thresholds), 2) check burst policy opt-in UX, 3) run regression to ensure pool doesn't hit soft max for single tenant.
Devon Patel: setting incident status -> mitigating. will keep thread updated.
Incident Bot: RESOLVED: Queue cleared, GPU util down to 45% for arcadia-prod. monitor for 15m.
Devon Patel: marking handoff to on-call next shift (Irene). leaving notes: added 2 gpus + burst ttl 30m, scale job id scale-1748004321-01, contact Priya/Arcadia for follow-up.
Irene Koh: ack, taking over post-mitigations. will schedule postmortem and notify product/security if needed.
Priya Singh: thanks team. please include recommended contract options for dedicated customers (burst add-on) in the PM follow-up. :thumbsup:
Support Bot: Customer incident ticket created: INC-2024-ARC-874.
Maya Chen: closing thread after monitoring window. great job everyone. :rocket:
